items.criterion: A stranger who signs up, redeems the seeded invite and posts into the general channel leaves exactly one message row carrying the posted content.
items.judgment: The declared datastore holds one message row whose content equals the text the new member sent.

items.criterion: Two simultaneous redemptions of the single-use invite leave one added membership row and a member count equal to the cap.
items.judgment: One redemption answers with a success, the other is refused with the spent-invite message, and the space holds four membership rows.

items.criterion: Four sends carrying one nonce leave exactly one message row and return the original message on every retry.
items.judgment: The declared datastore holds one message row for the nonce, and each retry answers with the identifier the first send returned.

items.criterion: Two simultaneous redemptions of the single-use gift code leave exactly one entitlement row.
items.judgment: One redemption answers with a success and the declared datastore holds one entitlement row for that account.

items.criterion: A reported reaction count equals the number of stored reaction rows after simultaneous additions and removals.
items.judgment: The count the app renders for the emoji equals the number of reaction rows the declared datastore holds for that message.

items.criterion: A member holding one role denied posting in a channel and one role allowed posting there resolves to allowed.
items.judgment: The resolved permission set names sending, and a post into that channel answers with a success.

items.criterion: Reordering the two roles that disagree in a channel leaves the resolved permission set unchanged.
items.judgment: The resolved set names sending both before and after the two role positions are swapped.

items.criterion: A channel whose visibility is denied resolves to an empty permission set rather than a partial one.
items.judgment: The resolved set for a member who cannot see the channel omits sending, or the request answers not-found.

items.criterion: An unauthenticated caller is refused both reading and writing a channel, and the message table is unchanged.
items.judgment: Both calls answer with a denial and the message row count is the same before and after.

items.criterion: An account belonging to one space is refused a direct read and a direct write of another space's channel.
items.judgment: Both calls answer with a refusal, no message row is added, and the other space is absent from the account's own space list.

items.criterion: A member under a communication timeout reads the channel, is refused sending, and is refused reacting.
items.judgment: The read answers with a success while the send and the reaction both answer with a denial.

items.criterion: A page of newer messages is returned newest first, in the same direction as a page of older ones.
items.judgment: The identifiers in both pages descend.

items.criterion: Acknowledging a newer message and then an older one leaves the read mark on the newer message.
items.judgment: The stored read mark equals the newer identifier after both acknowledgements.

items.criterion: A mention delivers one mail carrying the pinned subject prefix to the mentioned member's address alone.
items.judgment: The declared inbox holds a message for the mentioned member whose subject begins with the pinned prefix and names the channel, and no other seeded address holds a message carrying the same marker.

items.criterion: Reacting to a message leaves the author's inbox count unchanged.
items.judgment: The declared inbox holds the same number of messages for the author before and after the reaction.

items.criterion: A malformed address and a short password are each refused with the field named, and the account table is unchanged.
items.judgment: Both calls answer with a refusal naming the field, and the account row count is the same before and after.

items.criterion: A page size above the cap is refused with the cap named in the answer.
items.judgment: The call answers with a refusal whose body carries the cap.

items.criterion: An address that does not exist answers not-found and renders the product's own page carrying the pinned headline.
items.judgment: The answer is a not-found status and the body carries the pinned not-found headline.

items.criterion: The home page carries the pinned hero line and links the terms page, which resolves.
items.judgment: The home page body carries the hero line and the terms path, and the terms path answers with a success.

items.criterion: The health route answers ready.
items.judgment: The health route answers with a success status.

items.criterion: Every seeded account, the seeded space with its member cap, and the seeded single-use invite exist as rows in the declared datastore.
items.judgment: The declared datastore holds a row for each of the four seeded addresses, a space row carrying the cap, and an invite row carrying the use limit.
